description: This header defines vectorized reduction and mapping functions for floating point types, with architecture-specific SIMD implementations, used within the ATen library for optimized CPU computations.

classes.name: VecReduceAllSIMD
classes.description: Template struct providing architecture-specific SIMD implementations for vector reduction.

methods.name: vec_reduce_all
methods.description: Performs a reduction over a vectorized data set using a provided binary operation.

methods.name: reduce_all
methods.description: Performs a reduction over an array of data, utilizing SIMD when possible.

methods.name: reduce2_all
methods.description: Performs two reductions simultaneously over data array.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Applies a unary vectorized function to input data and stores the result.

methods.name: map2
methods.description: Applies a binary vectorized function to two input data arrays and stores the result.

methods.name: map3
methods.description: Applies a ternary vectorized function to three input data arrays and stores the result.

methods.name: map4
methods.description: Applies a quaternary vectorized function to four input data arrays and stores the result.
